submitted.rationale: Photocurrent was measured three times: Ca0.27 = 1.73 µA, Ca0.296 = 3.2 µA, Ca0.49 = 0.04 µA. The Mn-rich side is far better, and the peak is in the interior near Ca≈0.30. XRD shows one phase (Q≈2.776) from Ca 0.27 to 0.41, so the difference comes from composition within that phase, not from a phase change. Index 9 has the highest measured merit.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.04 µA; the Ca-rich end performs poorly
Not measured because the merit budget ran out. Same XRD phase, and the trend suggests merit falls off as Ca increases.
